subject: Procurement intake: docs for vendor setup & PO process
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@solsticelogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Procurement intake: docs for vendor setup & PO process

Hi Janelle —

Thanks again for the time this morning. To get Solstice set up in our vendor system and to enable PO issuance, procurement needs a handful of items from your side. Can you confirm you can provide the following by EOD Wednesday? If any items require more time, let me know and we can stagger the intake.

What we need from you:
- Completed W-9 (company name & EIN)
- Bank details (ACH routing + account) and a voided check or bank letter
- Signed Master Services Agreement (or review/redline if you have changes)
- Remittance address and billing contact (name/email/phone)
- Primary accounting contact and invoice cadence (email + recommended PO reference)
- Sample invoice showing required fields (we require PO number on invoice)
- Any compliance docs you can share (SOC 2 Type II or security questionnaire)

What Redwood will do for you:
- Create vendor record and assign a vendor ID
- Share Redwood PO template and instructions for referencing PO numbers on invoices
- Confirm payment terms (standard is net30; exceptions require manager approval)
- Send DocuSign link for MSA when ready

I've attached a short procurement intake checklist to make this easier (Procurement_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx).

Next steps: please attach the items above to a reply here and call out any questions about net terms or invoicing. Monica (cc'd) will own the vendor entry once we have the docs.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Procurement_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@solsticelogistics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: docs for vendor setup & PO process

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — attaching the W-9 and our bank details. See notes inline below.

- W-9 attached (W-9.pdf)
- Bank details attached (bank-details.xlsx) — includes ACH info and bank contact for verification

Question: our standard payment term is net45. We can accept net30 for strategic customers but would need confirmation in writing (or a PO that references agreed terms). Is net30 a hard requirement for Redwood, or is there flex?

I don't have the signed MSA yet — our legal team prefers to review your standard MSA before signing. If you can send the DocuSign link or attach the template, I will route to legal.

Thanks,
Janelle Park
Director of Finance Operations
Solstice Logistics

Attachments: W-9.pdf (pdf), bank-details.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: 2026-08-09T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: docs for vendor setup & PO process

Hi Janelle —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming receipt of the W-9 and bank file — thank you. A few quick clarifications and next steps: 

1) Payment terms: our standard operating term is net30. We can escalate net45 requests but those require approval from Finance leadership; to move faster, please indicate if net45 is a hard requirement for you and we will route the request. For now, we'll plan for net30 unless you flag otherwise.

2) MSA: attaching our PO template and sharing a DocuSign link for the standard MSA. Legal typically accepts our standard MSA with limited redlines; if Solstice sends specific contract language, please highlight the sections.

3) PO process overview (high level):
- Redwood issues POs from our procurement system (internal PO# format: RW-<year>-<seq>)
- Please include the PO number on the invoice (top-right) and on the expense line items
- Invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com and cc'ed to the billing contact you provide
- Payment method: ACH preferred; wire available for one-time exceptions

4) Vendor entry: Monica will create the vendor record after we have the W-9, bank details, and remittance address. Please confirm legal business name exactly as it appears on the W-9.

Links / attachments:
- Redwood PO template: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/Procurement/Templates/Redwood_PO_Template_v1.xlsx
- DocuSign (MSA): https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-link/ABC123
- Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx

If you can confirm whether net45 is required and provide a billing contact (name & email), we should be able to complete vendor setup by tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Vivek
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@solsticelogistics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: docs for vendor setup & PO process

Vivek —

Thanks, Vivek. Net45 is our preferred term, but we can accept net30 for the first three monthly invoices while our finance team confirms internal cashflow. I will route the MSA to legal today and expect to return a signed copy or redline within 48 hours. Attached is the signed copy of our vendor setup form for your records and our remittance address.

Billing contact:
- Martin Lee (billing@solsticelogistics.com)

I'll follow up once legal returns the MSA. Appreciate the clear checklist — makes this straightforward.

Best,
Janelle
Director of Finance Operations
Solstice Logistics

Attachments: signed-MSA.pdf (pdf)
